title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Answering the most common questions from our patients

items.q: How long does a session last?
items.a: Each session lasts about 45 minutes, depending on the service.

items.q: Do I need a doctor's referral?
items.a: No, it isn't required — you can book directly. If you do have one, it can be put to use, as we are contracted with EOPYY (the Greek national health fund).

items.q: How quickly will I see results?
items.a: We can give you an approximate answer after the assessment and history-taking — it varies from case to case.

items.q: How often will I need sessions?
items.a: For chronic symptoms, once a week is usually enough. For rehabilitation after surgery, 2–3 visits per week are typically needed — always depending on each individual case.

items.q: How do I cancel or reschedule an appointment?
items.a: You can contact us by phone at least 24 hours in advance.

items.q: Is your space easy to reach?
items.a: Yes — we are located near Patision and Acharnon streets, just 400 meters from the Agios Eleftherios station of the metro green line (Line 1).
